test_title: PYST 57: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) OR-VM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f7e77971ab62ec8dd8fc8e27fa4654facb0132c5def5a32be1229373763d144.png] 

Option 2) **QT-XP **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6edff0da268cadc13e7f10f222d64d88ea379ffd2d40557f27787f7608834f2.png] 

Option 3) MP-TK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92fc6941133ffc0074b16dbc22939b8c71d88fce5284e3245e5277a5e1c16ab3.png] 

Option 4) KN-RI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b36e481152735593d00963912bd14ce1cfba6c79b003e6128d7b43f4a9dce86a.png] 

Here, 'QT-XP' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
